status: Exploratory follow-up; this specification was written before running these new tests, after prior panel results were known. Not preregistered.
source: CPTAC pan-cancer data freeze v1.2, unchanged from the primary patient analysis
universe: Proteins with finite protein, RNA and CNV values for every purity-complete original patient, nonconstant protein/RNA values and nondegenerate own-adjusted residuals; no ARID1A in ranking or null panels
statistic: Spearman correlation of OLS residual protein values, each protein adjusted for its own RNA, CNV and patient purity; replicate the archived point estimates before proceeding
null: 20,000 size-six non-BAF sets per cohort and null type, compared with median of the six fixed contacts; one-sided competitive gene-set test with plus-one correction
matching: 100 nearest non-BAF proteins to each contact using Euclidean distance across four within-cohort percentile features: mean normalized protein value, protein SD, mean RNA value, RNA SD; six distinct sampled genes per null set; fixed complete detection in the universe; no claim of absolute abundance or covariance matching
multiplicity: BH across four competitive tests: two cohorts by size-only and matched null
PC_sensitivity: First 1, 3 and 5 PCs from standardized own-adjusted residual protein matrix excluding all named BAF-family members, added as covariates to the original fixed 12-protein regressions; point estimates only, no post-hoc optimum selection or significance tests
patient_influence: Leave each patient out once, refit the base fixed-panel regressions, retain every resulting panel contrast; descriptive
